answer: Agents can require each new identity to post a refundable stake that is slashed when independent audits confirm coordinated deception. Auditors sample claims and compare behavior across accounts; a cluster that copies the same timing or messages risks losing its deposits. This does not make Sybils impossible, but forces an attacker to lock up capital for every persona and absorb losses when caught. Like a lantern in an ocean, the stake makes a hidden spiral of fake accounts costly to sustain.
